operations.name: Add a tag to a contact
operations.description: Assigns an existing tag to a contact. User must have 'contacts' access role. `account_id` is derived from the authenticated user's account for the company.

tag_id.description: Unique identifier for the tag to assign

operations.name: Fetch call analytics by company
operations.description: Retrieves inbound and outbound call analytics grouped by account for one or more companies. `company_ids` is required (comma-separated UUIDs). `start_time` and `end_time` are optional; if either is missing, the last 6 months is used. Durations are in seconds. `call_count` / `total_duration` are inbound; `outgoing_*` are outbound.

start_time.description: Start of the analytics window (must be provided with end_time)

end_time.description: End of the analytics window (must be provided with start_time)

operations.name: Create a new contact
operations.description: Creates a new contact for a specific company. At least one of contact_phone or contact_email must be provided. User must have 'contacts' access role to create contacts.

contact_phone.description: Phone number of the contact (required if no email provided)

contact_email.description: Email address of the contact (required if no phone provided)

custom_fields.description: Optional list of custom fields to set for the contact

operations.name: Create a new tag
operations.description: Creates a new tag for a specific company. `status` is optional and defaults to `true`. User must have 'contacts' access role to create tags. `account_id` is derived from the authenticated user's account for the company.

status.description: Whether the tag is active (defaults to true)

operations.name: Delete a contact
operations.description: Permanently deletes a contact from the system. User must have 'contacts' access role to delete contacts.

contact_id.description: Unique identifier for the contact to delete

operations.name: Delete a tag
operations.description: Permanently deletes a tag from the system. User must have 'contacts' access role to delete tags.

tag_id.description: Unique identifier for the tag to delete

operations.name: Fetch account by id
operations.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific account by its unique identifier. Returns account details including access level, contact information, and last login time.

operations.name: Fetch all accounts for authenticated user
operations.description: Retrieves a list of all accounts associated with the authenticated user for a specific company. Returns account details including access level, contact information, and last login time.

operations.name: Fetch companies for authenticated user
operations.description: Retrieves a list of companies associated with the authenticated user's accounts. This endpoint fetches company information from the main SalesCaptain API based on the company IDs associated with the user's accounts.

operations.name: Fetch company by id
operations.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific company by its unique identifier.

operations.name: Fetch a single contact by id
operations.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific contact by its unique identifier.

operations.name: Fetch a single conversation by id
operations.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific conversation by its unique identifier.

operations.name: Fetch a single message by id
operations.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific message by its unique identifier.

operations.name: Fetch messages for a conversation (paginated)
operations.description: Retrieves a paginated list of messages for a specific conversation within a company. Supports sorting by created_at, pagination options, and optional created_before / created_after filters.

page_number.description: Page number for pagination (must be a positive integer)

items_per_page.description: Number of items per page (10-100, default 10)

created_before.description: Return only messages created before this ISO date-time

created_after.description: Return only messages created after this ISO date-time

operations.name: Health check endpoint
operations.description: Returns basic service information and health status

operations.name: List contacts for a company (paginated)
operations.description: Retrieves a paginated list of contacts associated with a specific company. Supports filtering, sorting, pagination, and optional `search_key`.

page_number.description: Page number for pagination (must be a positive integer)

items_per_page.description: Number of items per page (10-100, default 10)

search_key.description: Search contacts by name, phone, or email

operations.name: Get a specific conversation profile
operations.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific conversation profile by its unique identifier.

conversation_profile_id.description: Unique identifier for the conversation profile

operations.name: List conversation profiles for a company
operations.description: Retrieves all conversation profiles associated with a specific company. Conversation profiles represent communication channels like phone lines, email addresses, etc.

operations.name: List conversations for a company (paginated)
operations.description: Retrieves a paginated list of conversations associated with a specific company. Supports filtering, sorting, and pagination options.

page_number.description: Page number for pagination (must be a positive integer)

items_per_page.description: Number of items per page (10-100, default 10)

number.description: Filter conversations by contact phone number

email.description: Filter conversations by contact email address

conversation_profile_id.description: Filter conversations by conversation profile ID

awaiting_reply.description: When `true`, returns only conversations that are awaiting a reply

operations.name: Get a single custom field by id
operations.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific custom field definition by its unique identifier.

custom_field_id.description: Unique identifier for the custom field

operations.name: List all custom fields for a company
operations.description: Retrieves all custom field definitions associated with a specific company. Custom fields allow companies to store additional contact information.

operations.name: List all sms templates for a company
operations.description: Retrieves all active SMS templates associated with a specific company, grouped by template type (custom, review, refer, cx) plus an all list.

operations.name: List tags for a company
operations.description: Retrieves tags associated with a specific company. Optionally filter by `search_key` or `tag_name`.

search_key.description: Search tags by partial name match

tag_name.description: Filter tags by exact or specific tag name

operations.name: Remove a tag from a contact
operations.description: Removes an assigned tag from a contact. User must have 'contacts' access role. `account_id` is derived from the authenticated user's account for the company.

tag_id.description: Unique identifier for the tag to remove

Optional `template_id` can be provided to send a template message. `account_id` is resolved from the authenticated user's account that matches `company_id` (same as other company-scoped routes). message_body.description: Plain text body of the message to send

operations.name: Update an existing contact
operations.description: Updates an existing contact's information. At least one of name, phone, email, or custom_fields must be provided. User must have 'contacts' access role to update contacts.

contact_id.description: Unique identifier for the contact to update

phone.description: Updated phone number (set to empty string to remove)

email.description: Updated email address (set to empty string to remove)
